content.title: 动名词(-ing)作主语 / 宾语速查
content.intro: 动词加 -ing 变成动名词,具有名词性质,可作主语、动词宾语和介词宾语。判断口诀:句首/介词后 → 用 -ing;特定动词(enjoy/finish/mind 等)后 → 用 -ing。

rows: Helping others is rewarding.(动名词作主语,谓语用单数 is)
look forward to / be used to / be committed to + doing(此处 to 是介词)

specialRules.rule: 动名词作主语时被看作一个整体,谓语动词用单数
specialRules.mark: Giving makes us happy(makes 不用 make)

specialRules.rule: 这些动词后只接 -ing 不接 to do:enjoy, finish, mind, admit, avoid, consider, suggest, keep, practise, deny, imagine
介词后只能接 -ing,不能接 to do
specialRules.mark: good at singing √ / good at to sing ×

specialRules.rule: look forward to / be used to / be devoted to 中的 to 是介词,后接 -ing
specialRules.mark: look forward to seeing √ / to see ×

why: 动名词由动词变来,但具有名词性质,所以能像名词一样作主语和宾语;作主语时表示泛指或经常性的行为,被看作单数,谓语用单数。
gaokaoPoints: 动名词作主语 vs 不定式作主语:-ing 多表泛指/经常性(Seeing is believing),to do 多表具体一次的行为;作动词/介词宾语时按固定搭配只能用 -ing。
动词后接 -ing 还是 to do:remember/forget/stop/try + doing(已做)与 + to do(将做)含义不同,是高频考点。

examVsReal.real: You have to see it to believe it.
examVsReal.note: 考试爱考动名词作主语;真实口语常换成更口语化的句式

examVsReal.exam: I look forward to hearing from you.(书面/考试)
examVsReal.real: Can't wait to hear from you!
examVsReal.note: to 后用 -ing 是考点;真实口语常用 can't wait to do
